definitions.explanation: The row or line at the back, whether of seats, people, or a formation.

examples.japanese: {後列|こうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I sat in the back row.

examples.japanese: {後列|こうれつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧にくい。
examples.english: It's hard to see the stage from the back row.
If taller people move to the back row, it will be easier for those in front to see.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {後|こう} (back, rear) + ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line). The counterpart of ⟦{前列|ぜんれつ}→前列：20217_zenretsu⟧ (front row).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後列|こうれつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: back row seat
- {最後列|さいこうれつ}: the very back row
- {後列|こうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in the back row
- {後列|こうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移動|いどう}する→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧: to move to the back row

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前列|ぜんれつ}→前列：20217_zenretsu⟧: front row — the antonym
- ⟦{後方|こうほう}→後方：19126_kouhou⟧: the rear (area) — refers to a general area, not a specific row
- ⟦{最後尾|さいこうび}→最後尾：21693_saikoubi⟧: the very end of a line — specifically the tail of a queue

cross_references.label: the very end of a line
